author: Xeinpai
body:
there are some times who i woud not die and survive like 15 fights. here is the most under utilised pvp technique and what makes the bigest diference betwin me and other players.

the secret is an ancestral technique called s-step (literally ancestral, is from 2014) does someone use this technique? i use it constantly but i turn my self and useing w instead of s.

original video: https://youtu.be/XZSsC6ag_wU

here are the uses for it that i have discover:

  • ~20 blocks jumps (yes you can jump to the monument using this)
example: https://youtu.be/3ZP_003onzg?t=16s
i also have jumped in Daisy(realy long jump) and Halcyon I(5 times lol).
//the mindgame herre is important, u need to trick your opponets into hitting you.

  • go away to eat G.apples or bow-spaming(i use the bow like i would use a fishing rod and get op combos).

  • exit combos.
    example: https://youtu.be/3ZP_003onzg?t=38s.

i do it by turning 180 degrees, pressing w and jumping. is easy


is powerful, is simple you need to try it. 
:v
